note: Aggregate-only execution counts for the free, zero-auth card verifier. Each completed successful verification fires one payload-free POST beacon to /api/verify-count, which increments one daily bucket; nothing about the record, the card, the result value or the person is sent or stored, and no timestamp beyond the day bucket exists anywhere in this pipeline. days[] carries the daily buckets the landing workflow retained (buckets older than retention_days are dropped), so it is a retained window, never a lifetime total; a read-modify-write race on one bucket can skip an increment, so treat the figure as a floor. status 'no buckets' with an empty days array means no bucket has landed yet: empty is empty and is never written as zero.
